# `company.payment_write_offs`

The part of a receipt discount that wrote off an underpayment ("Write off the extra amount"), with its own account.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | ix_payment_write_offs_payment | — | Stable ULID of this underpayment write-off. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_payment_write_offs_payment | transactions.id | Customer receipt that wrote the short amount off. |
| `discount_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | payment_discounts.id | The receipt discount row on the same edge; its amount includes this write-off. |
| `application_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | applications.id | Settlement edge the write-off was taken on. |
| `invoice_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | transactions.id | Receivable document the write-off settled. |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Account debited for the write-off, such as Bad Debt. |
| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Amount written off, in home-currency minor units. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency of the amount. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp the write-off was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that recorded it. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it came through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the receipt that wrote it off. |
